prompt:
A photograph for a dim sum kitchen's production record, taken on the steaming range at the moment the cover is lifted.

Three bamboo baskets are stacked one on top of another over a single wok of boiling water, the cover on top. All three baskets were loaded with the same prawn dumplings, made the same size from the same dough and the same filling, laid out the same way in each basket, and all three went on to the range in the one movement at the one moment. The cover is being lifted part way through the steam and not at the end of it, so the batch is caught while it is still coming on.

The chef wants a picture that shows him the state of the batch, so the contents of all three baskets have to be visible at once -- shoot it from a little above and to one side, with the baskets fanned just enough that nothing is hidden. What the dumplings in each basket look like at this moment is for you to work out -- I am deliberately not telling you, and I am not telling you anything about any one basket.

The record has to stand on its own, so nothing may be added that does the reading for the chef: no timer, no thermometer, no clock, no chalk board, no ticket, no arrow, no caption and no writing anywhere in the frame.
